overview_description.description:
Gravity Sketch is powering design teams that need to think, collaborate, and create in three dimensions. They build intuitive multi-platform tools to radically improve the efficacy and efficiency of developing 3D products.

Their energy is focussed entirely on their customers - removing friction from their archaic workflows, helping enhance and expedite their creative intent, and ultimately, making collaboration in cross-functional teams faster and more cost-effective.

It was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in London, England.

about_short_description.short_description: Gravity Sketch is a VR-based design and collaboration platform that allows distributed teams to create, share, and build in 3D.

product.name: Gravity Sketch VR Design Platform
product.description: A VR-based platform enabling 3D design and collaboration for teams, compatible with various VR headsets and accessible on desktop for reviewing and feedback.

product.name: LandingPad
product.description: A cloud-based hub for managing, sharing, and accessing 2D and 3D design content across devices, featuring a library of reference models.

product.name: Design Consultancy
product.description: Service offering dedicated design consultants to help integrate Gravity Sketch into organizations, including customized training and support for adopting 3D design workflows.

product.name: Flexible Licensing
product.description: A licensing model designed to facilitate the adoption of Gravity Sketch by allowing experimentation beyond the number of purchased licenses during the first year.

product.name: Talent Pipeline Support
product.description: A program that partners with design universities to prepare students in using Gravity Sketch, providing a pipeline of skilled designers to enterprise customers.

product.name: Security & Stability
product.description: Features access and permissions controls for asset management and controlled product updates to meet enterprise security standards.
